text:
Elaine Park: Quick design review request — reworked the Private Setup wizard's networking step in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234. Key changes: combine "Test connection" + checks into a single "Run preflight" flow, inline results per check, and a compact stepper at top that shows pass/warn/fail counts. Can folks flag any UX or accessibility nits? Matt Chen: Love consolidating into one preflight. Quick copy thought: change the CTA from 'Run preflight' to 'Verify connectivity' — it's shorter and maps to user intent. Also suggest the top stepper read "Network checks — 2/5 passed" instead of just icons. Rana Singh: Agree on explicit counts. One product constraint: critical failures (NAT, routing to model endpoints) should block 'Continue'. Non-critical (time sync, optional DNS) can be 'Continue with warnings' and surfaced in a collapsible details panel. We need copy for that secondary CTA. Jordan Liu: Implementation notes — the preflight is async and can take 20-45s for some customers. We should show streaming results as they come in, not wait for the whole suite. Also add a retry button per-check. Example UI behavior: - show spinner + short message while each check runs - replace with green check / amber triangle / red x when done Samir Patel: Accessibility nits from initial scan: do not rely on color alone. Each result row needs an icon + text status and an aria-live region so screen readers announce updates. Also keyboard: ensure the collapsible details and per-check retry buttons are tabbable in logical order. Suggested snippet for announcement area: ```html
DNS check passed. NAT check failed.
``` Also contrast: current orange (#FFAA33) fails 4.5:1 on small text — either darken or use bold + icon. a11y-bot: automated-lint: contrast-warning on .badge--warning (ratio 3.2:1). recommend #D97706 or 18pt bold. Matt Chen: UX nit — when a check fails, focus should move to the failing item or the collapsible so keyboard users can act quickly. Also show an inline 'why this matters' one-liner (e.g., 'NAT required to reach model pools — blocks inference'). Jordan Liu: For the network engineer audience, include an expandable raw output view with copyable logs and a `curl` example for testing the endpoint. E.g.: ```bash curl -v https://example-redwood-endpoint/status ``` Keep raw output collapsed by default. Rana Singh: Copy suggestions for the warning CTA: 'Continue with warnings (not recommended)'. For blocked CTA: 'Fix network issues to continue'. Also add a tooltip on the stepper explaining what counts as critical. Elaine Park: Thanks — I'll: 1) update Figma with count text + clearer CTAs, 2) add aria-live example and focus rules in the spec, 3) swap orange to the darker token Samir suggested, and 4) add a collapsed raw output pane. Will re-post frames in ~2 hours. @Samir @Jordan can you check the aria focus flow when I post the next frames? :thumbsup: Samir Patel: happy to review once posted. Jordan Liu: will prototype streaming results and per-check retry. Elaine Park: filing a quick follow-up issue for copy variants (PM to pick) and accessibility checklist — thanks everyone!
